KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

1. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Ujumbe na fani katika matini elezi.

3. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Matumizi ya Lugha 1.4.1 Aina za Maneno Aina za: - Nomino - Vivumishi.

4. C — watoto

5. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fasihi Simulizi 1.1.1 Misingi ya Fasihi Simulizi Fasihi Simulizi katika Jamii ya.

6. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Utangulizi wa Bunilizi na Kazi za Kihalisia.

11. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufasaha Kifungu cha kupasha habari.

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Ufahamu wa Kusikiliza Ujumbe na fani katika matin.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Uchambuzi wa Wasifu; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
